time_definition: trace-attributed presentation latency: from the page's own stamp to the compositor's record of presenting the frame that the correlation rule attributes to it. It is not a photon latency, and it does not prove that every change in that frame was caused by the marked operation, found with the wider qualifier.
cold_start_definition: performance.now() in the page when the first panel is on screen, which is from the start of the navigation
teardown: not measured: the gallery builds each panel once and only hides it afterwards, so a visit and a revisit are not a teardown
